% Pattern: attach/ref. A label can hold a comma, as \label{lem b_n,m}: a
% proof whose head refers to it proves the item of the whole label. Seen in
% the gold pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 1.2
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem b_n}
Every convergent sequence is bounded.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem b_n,m}
Every double sequence that converges is bounded from some index on.
\end{lemma}

\section{Proofs}

\begin{proof}[Proof of Lemma \ref{lem b_n,m}]
Take the limit and a ball around it.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
